_comment: Public texts of the task page and the scorecard (site/build.py). `title` and `subtitle` replace task.json's title; `references` and `baselines` describe each design in one sentence (the internal notes of task.json and tests/expected.json are never shown).
title: N × N matrix multiplication, clocked
subtitle: Multiply two signed N × N matrices, wrapping at AccW bits, behind a start/done handshake.
banlist_note: No task-specific ban, `*` included: the task is the schedule (how many multipliers, how many cycles, how short a cycle), and the score prices it. Run-time `/ % **` are banned here as in every task: a zero divisor or a negative exponent makes an unknown value from known operands.

references.matmul_g1: N × N parallel multiply-accumulate units and one step counter: A and B are captured into shift registers at `start`, and `done` rises N steps later (latency N).
